text_block_list.text:
Taking a breather between training sessions, 
I was walking through town with <chrname> when--

Hearing <chrname>'s name 
spoken in French, 
I turned toward it on reflex.

text_block_list.name: Paris Local B
text_block_list.text:
"A horsegirl from Japan. 
She's pretty strong over there, and apparently 
she's running in the Arc de Triomphe soon."

It seemed there were people in Paris 
who knew about <chrname> 
after all.

I worked up my nerve and spoke to them 
in the French I'd been learning!

text_block_list.name: Paris Local B
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! So it really was 
<chrname>! 
I watch your UmaTube videos--I'm rooting for you~"

text_block_list.name: Paris Local A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, you both understand French. 
Did you study it?"

Meeting fans in Paris seemed to be 
a precious experience 
for <chrname> too!

text_block_list.name: Paris Local B
text_block_list.text:
"Watching her on UmaTube, working so hard 
to make it to the Arc de Triomphe... 
it just made me want to cheer her on..."

text_block_list.name: Paris Local A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, so you won't be cheering for our own girl genius? 
You fickle thing~"

text_block_list.name: Paris Local B
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong with that! 
You can root for as many horsegirls as you like!"

<chrname>, who had been studying French 
alongside me, seemed to catch 
every word of that happy exchange.
